cases.purpose: Status queries handle empty names, duplicate shadow entries and long password fields without authentication diagnostics.
cases.oracle: The first matching shadow row determines L for ! or *, NP for an empty password field, and P for any other nonempty field; an empty passwd name is not an account. An empty shell reports /bin/sh.
cases.comparison: Exact status, output and success diagnostics for private fixture queries.
cases.script:
[[ $(type -t passwd) == builtin ]] || exit 99
export PHCLIB_PASSWD=passwd.fixture PHCLIB_SHADOW=shadow.fixture BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0
for n in empty locked longhash ''; do
  passwd info "$n" > out 2> err; rc=$?
  [[ -s err ]] && d=yes || d=no
  printf '%s rc=%d diag=%s out=[%s]\n' "${n:-<empty>}" "$rc" "$d" "$(< out)"
done
cases.stdout:
empty rc=0 diag=no out=[empty uid=1 gid=1 home=/e shell=/bin/sh password=NP]
locked rc=0 diag=no out=[locked uid=2 gid=2 home=/l shell=/bin/sh password=L]
longhash rc=0 diag=no out=[longhash uid=3 gid=3 home=/h shell=/bin/sh password=P]
<empty> rc=1 diag=yes out=[]
